lines.text: I'm doing tomorrow's grumbling tonight. During the rain I'll be busy drawing umbrellas.
lines.fact: Tomorrow it rains from 1 pm, so take the umbrella.
lines.meaning: Idea 01, Grumbling in advance. The screen gets its complaining about tomorrow done tonight. The only German evening lines you kept do exactly this („Man kann sich schon heute drüber ärgern“, „bei den Wettergöttern beschwert“). Works in any weather.
lines.hint: Idea 01: judge the direction; use the note for the idea

lines.text: Ich meckere heute schon mal vor. Morgen reicht dann ein Seufzer.
lines.fact: Morgen regnet's ab 13 Uhr, denk also an den Schirm.

lines.text: I asked if tomorrow's cold could wait a week. It's already left the house.
lines.fact: Tomorrow it's colder from 1 pm.
lines.meaning: Idea 02, Haggling with the weather. The screen tried to get tomorrow changed, and lost. Extends the two kept lines (the weather gods, sitting on it for drama): the screen has an agenda and fails at it.
lines.hint: Idea 02: judge the direction; use the note for the idea

lines.text: Somewhere, tomorrow's rain is getting an early night. Big day ahead.
lines.fact: Tomorrow it rains from 1 pm, so take the umbrella.

lines.text: If this changes overnight, I'll quietly redraw it and act like it was always that way.
lines.fact: Tomorrow's outfit works all day.
lines.meaning: Idea 04, Covering up overnight changes. Forecasts change overnight and the screen really does redraw itself. It admits it will do that quietly and save face. True to the device, honest about the forecast, any weather.

lines.text: Ändert sich das über Nacht, mal ich's heimlich um und tu so, als wär nichts gewesen.
lines.fact: Das Outfit für morgen passt den ganzen Tag.

lines.text: Once the lights go out, nobody can see me. That's e-ink. Read fast.
lines.fact: Tomorrow it rains from 1 pm, so take the umbrella.
lines.meaning: Idea 05, E-ink in the dark. A device truth only TRMNL owners know: no backlight, so once the lights go out nobody can read it. The screen makes that the reader's problem. Any weather.

lines.text: Next on this screen, probably the stocks. Also forecasting a drop.
lines.fact: Tomorrow it's colder from 1 pm.
lines.meaning: Idea 06, The playlist neighbours. TRMNL rotates several plugins on one screen. The weather screen comments on whatever comes on after it. Fresh and very TRMNL, but it guesses what else is on the reader's playlist.

lines.text: You told me you're always cold. Tomorrow you get to be right.
lines.fact: Tomorrow it's colder from 1 pm.
lines.batch: Idea 09: Your own settings, used against you
lines.meaning: Idea 09, Your own settings, used against you. The screen knows what the reader told it: always cold, always hot, when they head out. At 11 it throws that back. Needs a little logic (lines that only show with a setting).

lines.text: The rain told us exactly when it's coming. No repairman has ever managed that.

lines.meaning: Idea 12, The weather keeps its appointments. Tomorrow's weather comes with an exact time. Nobody else in life manages that. German has the obvious target, which may be too obvious.
